Zoom into the itinerary interval and locate the point that repeats the same word.

[[D38]]

readingRefinements.old: The magnification is labeled; a two-pixel sliver must not become an apparently unchanged interval.
readingRefinements.new: The magnification label lets you compare the local detail with the shrinking interval on the full ruler.

readingRefinements.old: These dense periodic points coexist with sensitive dependence; they do not mean that every orbit is periodic.
readingRefinements.new: The same covering argument explains sensitive dependence. Any arbitrarily small starting neighborhood contains a cylinder whose image is the entire unit interval after n steps. At that time choose an image endpoint at least 1/2 away from the reference image; its preimage is a nearby start that has separated. The fixed separation scale can therefore be reached from arbitrarily close starts. The dense periodic points do not mean that every orbit is periodic.

readingRefinements.new: That short-time agreement answers a narrower question than long-term forecast accuracy.
